name: button
description: A native button or link with variants, sizes and per-instance classes.

variant.description: Visual treatment; unknown values fall back to default.

size.description: Component scale; unknown values fall back to default.

href.description: Trusted link URL. Omit to render a button.

disabled.description: Boolean. Disables a button or removes navigation from a link.

dataPortal.description: Optional native Ghost Portal action for enabled links.
